name: Narmada Academic Republic
notes: The enlightenment nation. A council of field historians and naturalists governs the central plateau and licenses fossil-energy extraction. Formed from the consolidation of Narmada University's scholars, clerks and plateau city-dwellers: a constitutional republic of field historians, naturalists and comparative anatomists, proud of its telescopes, printing presses and empirical science. Its university city is cream-and-brick halls and glass greenhouses over basalt cliffs. A nation of the Age of Machinery, on the pre-Shattering chart.
